theorem: For either of the two explicit grid ranges below, every local linear map on a five-dimensional subsystem with rank <=4 sends the range to one spanned by Schmidt-rank<=2 vectors; any further local map on the opposite subsystem preserves the property. Thus no nonzero 4x4 local-filter image of a positive state with exactly either source range can be certified SN>=3 by the generalized Schmidt-rank-two range criterion, irrespective of ranks or complex coefficients of the two filters. This does NOT assert SN<=2 or preclude a non-range witness.
two_imported_written_results: For the 2025 4x5 grid source range S45, frontier-20261028-grid-projection-full-span-v1.json SHA256 3cebc491cbdb653506dbb138c3b3b417988ae17396ef14bc636b187e84526213 proves that the Bob image under every complex rank-four map C^5->C^4 is SR2-spanned.

For the 2024 5x5 grid source range S55, frontier-20261028-grid55-all-rank4-projection-range-v1.json SHA256 e20389fa9f0c53cdc7c70d112f5d2c0cc184f52db3a3c3c3f0c3971559789e10 proves the same for every complex rank-four map on Alice or Bob, with explicit polynomial-checked anchor vectors in both charts.
factorization_proof: Let K:C^5->C^m have rank<=4. Choose a line ell contained in ker K, and let Q:C^5->C^4 be any surjection with ker Q=ell. There exists a unique linear map L:C^4->C^m such that K=LQ. The imported result says (Q tensor I)S has a spanning family of SR<=2 vectors. Applying L on the same side and any arbitrary map M on the other side maps this family to vectors of SR<=2 and spans (K tensor M)S. This argument also covers rank0; a zero output has no normalized state. For positive rho with range S, ran((K tensor M)rho(K tensor M)^*)=(K tensor M)S, so every nonzero output has the asserted range. Both local maps forming a 4x4 state necessarily have output rank<=4; on S45 apply the factorization to the five-dimensional Bob side, and on S55 to either side.
limits: This is a deduction from the two pinned same-harness written results, not a separately independently reviewed theorem or novelty claim. It is a barrier to the range-spanning method for two particular source ranges, not to all 4x4 PPT/SN3 constructions, general 2-block-positive witnesses, or high Schmidt number surviving the projection. The original target remains open.
